<repaired_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
const ll MOD = 1000000007;

// Calculate sum of digits of n in base k
ll digitSum(ll n, int k) {
    ll sum = 0;
    while (n > 0) {
        sum += n % k;
        n /= k;
    }
    return sum;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    ll n;
    int k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    // Generate the sequence a_0, a_1, ..., a_{n-1}
    vector<ll> a(n);
    for (ll i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        a[i] = digitSum(i, k);
    }
    
    // Count distinct subsequences using DP
    // dp[i] = number of distinct subsequences ending with value i
    // total = total number of distinct subsequences so far
    // For each new element x, new_subsequences = total + 1 (including empty subsequence)
    // But we need to avoid duplicates: if x appeared before, subtract the count from last time
    
    unordered_map<ll, ll> lastCount;
    ll total = 1; // Start with empty subsequence
    
    for (ll x : a) {
        ll prev = lastCount[x];
        ll newSubseq = (total - prev + MOD) % MOD;
        lastCount[x] = total;
        total = (total + newSubseq) % MOD;
    }
    
    // Subtract 1 to exclude the empty subsequence if needed
    // But problem says empty sequence is a subsequence, so we include it
    cout << (total - 1 + MOD) % MOD << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
